no_adcom_quote.quote: I concur with the medical review team regarding the efficacy evaluation for this product.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for NDA022023 (EMEND / fosaprepitant dimeglumine for Injection), a bridging application for the intravenous pro-drug formulation of the already-approved oral aprepitant. A full-text search of every original review document (Medical Review, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacology, Chemistry, Microbiology, Naming, Approvable letter, Approval letter, and Administrative Correspondence) for 'advisory committee', 'committee', 'voted', and 'convened' returned no matches. The approval decision rested on the review team and internal consults (e.g., the Division of Cardiovascular and Renal Products consult on the diltiazem blood-pressure interaction), with no AdComm referenced; no linkages between an AC and approval changes exist.
